subject: New vendor setup: privacy intake, DPA questions, and PO steps for Brightwell Health
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Soto <anna.soto@brightwellhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor setup: privacy intake, DPA questions, and PO steps for Brightwell Health

Hi Anna —

Thanks again for the call this morning. We're excited to get Brightwell set up on Redwood for the pilot. To keep the onboarding moving, a few asks from procurement/privacy so we can get a PO out and DPA in place: 

1) DPA: Do you require Redwood to sign Brightwell's DPA, or are you open to executing Redwood's standard DPA (I can attach a draft)? If you have redlines, please flag them.

2) Subprocessors: Can you send your current subprocessor list (name + country + purpose)? A simple spreadsheet is fine.

3) Data retention: For the pilot, what retention period do you expect for request logs, generated outputs, and backups? Any regulatory constraints we should be aware of?

4) PO / invoicing: What is your preferred purchase order flow (PO issued before onboarding vs net-30 after onboarding)? Please include billing contact and remit-to details.

If possible, please reply with the subprocessor list and any DPA preference by EOD tomorrow so procurement can draft the PO. I’ve cc'd Lauren (procurement) and Karthik (legal) to pick up next steps.

Drive link to our onboarding checklist and standard DPA: https://drive.google.com/open?id=0Bxyz-example-onboarding-forms

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0162
[Attachment: Redwood-Onboarding-Checklist.pdf (link)]

From: Anna Soto <anna.soto@brightwellhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightwellhealth.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:05:23 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor setup: privacy intake, DPA questions, and PO steps for Brightwell Health

Marcus —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers inline below and attached a subprocessor spreadsheet.

> 1) DPA: Do you require Redwood to sign Brightwell's DPA, or are you open to executing Redwood's standard DPA?
We typically ask our vendors to sign Brightwell's DPA but are open to Redwood's standard DPA if there are significant commercial reasons. We can share our redline requests after your legal team reviews.

> 2) Subprocessors: Can you send your current subprocessor list?
Attached: Brightwell-Subprocessors-20260811.xlsx (contains our vendors handling analytics, hosting backups, and email delivery).

> 3) Data retention: For the pilot, what retention period do you expect?
For patient-facing feature tests we'll need request logs and generated outputs retained for 90 days by default; backups can be archived for up to 1 year. If there are specific encryption or isolation requirements, please let us know.

> 4) PO / invoicing: What is your preferred purchase order flow?
Procurement will issue a PO prior to the first invoice. Our accounts payable prefers net-30 after receipt of an invoice with PO number. Billing contact: invoices@brightwellhealth.com. Remit to: Brightwell Health, 410 Elm St., Suite 200, Portland, OR, 97204.

We can circulate a DPA redline set after your legal team sends the Redwood DPA. Looking forward to the pilot.

Best,
Anna Soto
Vendor Programs Manager, Brightwell Health
anna.soto@brightwellhealth.com | +1 503-555-9124

[Attachment: Brightwell-Subprocessors-20260811.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Soto <anna.soto@brightwellhealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:32:10 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor setup: privacy intake, DPA questions, and PO steps for Brightwell Health

Hi Anna — and thanks Marcus for looping us in. Quick procurement note to make the PO path explicit so Brightwell can plan: 

Procurement steps (timeline estimate in parentheses):
- Complete privacy intake + confirm DPA path (Redwood DPA or Brightwell DPA) (1–3 business days for initial review)
- Billing & vendor profile collection (W9 or equivalent, remit-to) (1 business day after docs received)
- PO issuance (after DPA terms agreed and vendor profile complete) — PO will contain the pilot SKU and estimated spend (2 business days)
- Kickoff & invoice processing (PO number must be on invoices)

Please send the preferred DPA and W9 (or local tax form). We prefer to have the PO in place before provisioning production resources; for pilot sandbox access we can provision earlier on an internal non-billable token.

I've attached our short PO guide with required fields and the billing email for Redwood finance. Marissa will create the vendor record in HubSpot and send a DocuSign envelope if needed.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai | +1 646-555-2248

[Attachment: Redwood-PO-Guide-20260812.pdf (pdf)]

Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:02:04 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor setup: privacy intake, DPA questions, and PO steps for Brightwell Health

Anna — thanks for the fast turnaround and for the subprocessors file. Next steps from our side: 

- Karthik will circulate Redwood's standard DPA to Brightwell legal by EOD tomorrow for initial review. Karthik, please note Brightwell prefers their DPA but is open — watch for redlines.
- Lauren / Marissa: please create the vendor profile and begin the PO draft once W9/remit details are confirmed. Marissa, can you create the HubSpot company record (use HubSpot id: 67890) and start a DocuSign envelope if needed?
- Hannah: note Brightwell's retention ask (90 days logs, 1 year backups) — please confirm that aligns with our pilot logging config and any compliance notes.

Anna, we'll follow-up with the Redwood DPA and a PO timeline once the vendor profile is in place. If you can send the W9 and any billing contact forms to marissa_cole@redwood.ai that will speed things up.

Thanks all — look forward to getting the pilot live next week.

Marcus Lin
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0162
